body:
My grandma has 4 brugs so I have been experimenting a little with them. I have bipolar and anxiety so I took my clonazepam but then decided to smoke some brug leaf. My mind set was a peaceful one, since I had just taken my afternoon dose of clonazepam. About 10 minutes after I took it, I decided to smoke the leaf. It only made the effects of the clonazepam work better. I felt more relaxed, although my heart beat was a little elevated, which went away shortly after. I'm not quit sure if it is safe to smoke brugmansia if one is taking bipolar meds or antidepressants or not, but I just had to try it.
